title.en: thursday open stage at la manufacture chanson.
title.de: donnerstags offene bühne in der manufacture chanson.
title.tr: la manufacture chanson'da perşembe açık sahne.

line.en: the jeudi chanson open stage at la manufacture chanson in paris 11 is listed for 20:30. new singers and the school's trainees take the stage; it repeats every thursday.
line.de: die offene bühne jeudi chanson in der la manufacture chanson in paris 11 ist für 20:30 angesetzt. neue sänger und die schüler der schule stehen auf der bühne; sie wiederholt sich jeden donnerstag.
line.tr: paris 11'deki la manufacture chanson'ın jeudi chanson açık sahnesi 20:30 olarak listede. yeni şarkıcılar ve okulun stajyerleri sahneye çıkıyor; her perşembe tekrarlanıyor.
